artworks.title: Te Po (The Long Night)
artworks.description: The image shows flowing lines and shapes arranged in an abstract composition. There is a rounded form at the top left with elongated, undulating shapes radiating from it. Below are curved lines and irregular areas of color, suggesting hills or clouds. A bright yellow band runs through the center. A small, intricate circle with flame-like patterns is present below the yellow band. The lines also form figures seated facing left. The inscription "TE PO" is at the bottom left of the image.

artworks.title: The Tree of Man's Life
artworks.description: This is a drawing of "The Tree of Man's Life," which symbolizes various stages and moral conditions of human life. The artwork features intricate details with branches representing virtues and vices. The tree is depicted at the center with roots in moral and natural foundations and branches extending to different outcomes. Key images include a skeleton symbolizing mortality and a central motif of "Christ" at the top representing a spiritual connection or goal. The drawing contains text, symbolic illustrations, and allegorical elements conveying a moral and spiritual message, typical of historical emblem books and moral texts.

artworks.title: Gheraert van der Spronck
artworks.description: The image shows a man with wavy hair styled back, a thin mustache and a pointed beard. He is dressed in period clothing with an elaborate ruffled collar and layers of fabric draped over his shoulders. The portrait is bordered in an oval frame with inscriptions around it, set against a textured paper background.

artworks.title: Cardinal Charles de Bourbon
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in an ornate chair. He is positioned sideways but facing forward, with his left arm resting on a book on a table beside him. He has delicate features, a long narrow nose, a high forehead, light-colored hair covered by a cap, and is wearing an elaborate clerical robe. The robe is textured and detailed, with patterns cascading down to his feet. There are no jewelry or objects in his hands, and the background features intricate scrollwork, heraldic shields, and a tiled floor.

artworks.title: Old Woman on a Swing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure on a swing. The drawing depicts a figure seated on a swing made of ropes or wooden elements. The figure's posture suggests they are in motion, captured mid-swing, as they grip the swing with both hands. Above the figure, another unidentified shape or object extends horizontally across the image. The background appears to be textured, potentially suggesting foliage or rough outdoor surroundings, created through an intricate pattern of lines and shading to add depth and movement to the scene.

artworks.title: Old Man on a Swing
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and/or lavis on heavy laid paper  [printed in the Calcografia in 1859 for John Saville Lumley]
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a swing. The individual is smiling, holding onto the swing ropes with their legs stretched out in front of them. They have sparse hair and are wearing dark clothing with a lighter colored shirt visible underneath. Their feet are bare. The background is textured and dark.

artworks.title: Marcelle la Blonde
artworks.description: The image is a drawn portrait of a person seen from the shoulders up, facing the viewer with a subtle head tilt to the right. The individual has large eyes, arched eyebrows, full lips, and hair styled low across the forehead and in a bun at the back. They are depicted wearing a draped garment with minimal detailing, and an earring is visible. In the background, there are horizontal lines to the right. The drawing is monochromatic on textured paper with the names "Marcelle La Blonde" and "Juan Gris" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Marcelle la Brune
artworks.description: This image shows a line drawing of an individual from the shoulders up. The person is positioned in a three-quarter profile view, looking to the left. Their facial features include large, almond-shaped eyes, a prominent nose, and full lips. The hair is styled in a short, wavy bob that frames the face. The person is depicted wearing a simple, rounded-collared garment. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background consists of light, abstract geometric shapes. The words "MARCELLE LA BRUNE" are written underneath the person's image, along with the artist's name, Juan Gris, and a date, "3.21."

artworks.title: The Corral
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph with watercolor and ink
artworks.description: This image shows a rural scene with a group of donkeys gathered in a semi-circle, facing different directions. Behind them are cows with brown and white patches, some lounging and others walking around. In the background is a simple wooden house with a thatched roof, and next to it is a large roll-like structure, possibly a hay wagon. The landscape includes earth-toned hills, fields, and a light blue sky. The painting style features loose, flowing brushstrokes with a muted palette of browns, greens, and blues, creating an impressionistic feel.

artworks.title: Hut in Trinidad
artworks.description: The image shows two people seated in front of a rustic hut. Both individuals are visible from head to toe. The person on the left is an adult with short hair, dressed in a long pink garment and seated with a child on their lap. The child is wrapped in a lighter-colored cloth. A thatched roof covers the wooden structure behind them. Items such as discarded metal sheets, wooden boards, and clay or stone pots are scattered around the dwelling. Near the door, there is a rooster and a hen walking on the ground. In the background, there is a clear, blue sky with the top of a palm tree visible.

artworks.title: Creation of Eve
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a scene featuring a bearded figure seated on the ground, with another figure emerging from the earth receiving a gesture. Various animals like cows, lions, and birds are around them, with trees in the background. Celestial bodies like the sun, moon, and stars are shown above. The design features intense contrast, fine lines, and detailed textures.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Eve
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a natural setting with a tree and various animals. The image includes a tree, branches, leaves, a deer, a goat, and a snake on the trunk. The landscape features hills, and the drawing is detailed with intricate etching lines. The text in German below suggests a narrative or allegorical theme. The scene is rich in symbolic elements.

artworks.title: The Fall of Man
artworks.description: The image displays two figures, a man and a woman, standing on opposite sides of a tree. The man stands on the left, holding his chin with one hand and resting the other on the tree. The woman stands on the right, looking towards the man and holding the tree with both hands. The figures have stylized facial features, with the man having short, curly hair and the woman with long, wavy hair. Both figures appear nude. A serpent is wrapped around the tree, facing the woman. In the background, there is a sparse landscape with sketch-like trees, hills, and small animal figures like a deer.

artworks.title: Melchizedek with Bread and Wine
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures interacting. The scene shows several figures engaged in an encounter. One figure on the left appears to wear a military or authoritative attire and gestures towards a central figure with a distinctive headdress resembling horns. Allied or opposing figures are positioned around them, some carrying objects indicating offerings or gifts, such as a platter with stacked items. The background presents a simple landscape with no detailed elements, focusing attention on the figures. A block of text in the lower portion appears to be in German script. The composition and details suggest it might relate to an event involving significant characters in the scene.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Isaac
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel stopping a man with a raised knife from making a sacrifice. The man stands over an altar with a bound figure, while the angel intervenes. In the background, there are landscapes with trees, hills, and livestock. Text is inscribed below the artwork. The detailed etching work captures the tension of the scene. An additional figure observes the central action.

artworks.title: Jacob Wrestling with the Angel
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing depicting a biblical scene. Various animals are being herded across the landscape by figures. In the foreground, a group of figures sits and kneels, one holding a child. A shepherd guides the animals. Towards the right, two figures are depicted in an embrace or struggle, with soldiers or warriors marching above them. The drawing features intricate line work and shading, reminiscent of woodcut or etching techniques. A passage from Genesis is written at the bottom of the image. The overall tone is historical and narrative-driven.

artworks.title: Joseph Recounts His Dreams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered together with celestial symbols in the sky. The drawing depicts a group of men standing close to one another engaged in what appears to be a serious conversation or interaction. At the top right of the image, there are celestial symbols including a sun, a crescent moon, and an array of stars depicted in the sky, partially obscured by billowing clouds. In the background, there are hills or dunes, and in the foreground, there is text written in German. The style is reminiscent of woodcut prints or engravings commonly seen in early printmaking.

artworks.title: Joseph Thrown into the Well
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several men surrounding a hole with one figure trapped inside. The men are shown pulling on ropes or gesturing animatedly. The scene takes place outdoors with trees, buildings, and animals in the background. Old-fashioned text at the bottom adds to the narrative context. The figures are depicted with muscular detail and dynamic poses.

artworks.title: Joseph Sold to the Ishmaelites
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people and camels engaged in various actions in an outdoor setting. The composition depicts several individuals clustered around a table-like structure. The scene is set in an arid environment, suggested by the presence of camels laden with goods. In the background, other figures are engaged in activities around a large basin or container. The drawing captures a moment of bustling activity, with detailed rendering of clothing, facial expressions, and animals. Various items like barrels and packs are drawn with attention to detail, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Finding of Moses
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of women by a riverbank. The central figure, wearing a crown, is reaching towards a person in the river who is holding a baby wrapped in cloth. The background includes trees, hills, and lush landscape details. The drawing is detailed and elegant. The bottom of the drawing features German text in decorative script.

artworks.title: Moses and the Burning Bush
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure emerging from clouds in front of a kneeling figure on a hillside. The image shows a bearded figure amidst swirling clouds reaching out towards a kneeling figure on a hillside. The foreground features a flock of sheep grazing, while the background shows rolling hills and a village in a valley. The scene is rendered in a monochrome line style and includes an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Moses and the Serpent
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man near a flaming bush. The man stands on the right side with one hand stretched towards the burning bush. Another figure emerges from the bush. The bush is depicted with flames and smoke, stylized with intricate lines. The background shows a landscape with trees and hills. The lines in the drawing are detailed. At the bottom, there is text in an older form of the German language.

artworks.title: Moses Closing the Red Sea
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting the parting of waters in a biblical scene. The illustration shows a large group of figures walking along a dry path through a body of water, led by a figure at the front holding a staff. The parted waters reveal chaotic waves with several figures and objects being consumed by the sea. Behind the group, the sea appears turbulent, and some animals seem to be struggling against the current. The scene is rich in detail with intricate cross-hatching defining the contours of the figures and landscape. The expression and posture of the figures suggest determination and purpose as they move forward. At the bottom, there is an inscription that appears to relate to the biblical story of the Exodus, adding a textual element to the visual narrative.

artworks.title: Moses Striking the Rock
artworks.description: The image shows several figures positioned across the frame. In the center, a man with a long beard is standing and holding a staff, gesturing towards a rock with water flowing from it. He is surrounded by other bearded men in long robes. Women and children are collecting water in jugs, and some animals are drinking from the stream. In the background, there are pitched tents. A block of text at the bottom includes references to religious scripture (Exo. 17.a. and g.Reg.19.a.b.).
